department: Department of Earth, Geographic, and Climate Sciences

deadline.value: Apply by January 5 for the MS or PhD beginning the following September.
deadline.quote: January 5th is the deadline for the receipt of application materials for acceptance into the Geosciences MS or PhD program beginning the following September.

supervisor.value: Admission depends on faculty support, and the sponsoring faculty member must agree to provide much of your funding, so contact potential advisors before applying.
supervisor.quote: Acceptance into the Geosciences graduate program depends upon meeting academic standards, having faculty support and securing funding. | The faculty member who sponsors your application must agree to provide a substantial portion of your financial package through their research grants.

funding.value: The program admits only students it can fund (typically four years for PhD students), but only about five to eight of 50 to 75 applicants are funded each year.
funding.quote: Our program does not accept students for whom it cannot provide financial support, thus many admission decisions come down to availability of funding.

also.quote: Of those, we are able to fund only five to eight students.

entry_route.value: The PhD does not take students without an MS; applicants with a bachelor's apply to the MS/PhD track instead.
entry_route.quote: The Geosciences program does not accept students without a MS degree into the PhD program.

also.quote: Students with a bachelor’s degree who wish to pursue a PhD can apply for the MS/PhD track

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Geography PhD is a separate program in the same department.
